capabilities: Browse assets in a masonry gallery with filters, search, and batch operations
Curate assets on infinite canvas boards with annotations and per-board layouts
Edit metadata including titles, tags, star ratings, source links, and AI generation prompts
Organize assets in a synced folder tree with drag-and-drop import
Inspect assets in a detail lightbox with zoom, navigation, and copyable prompts
extras: Not yet in the community store; manual installation from release files is required. The README notes write-ahead backups, corruption guards, and auto-reload for cloud-synced vaults, and states data is stored as JSON plus original files readable without the plugin.
intentEvidence: Eagle/Billfish are asset libraries with no canvas and closed data formats
motivation: The author found no single tool combining four asset types, prompt metadata, and canvas curation with local data ownership, so they built it into Obsidian where data stays portable and syncs with existing setups.
problem: Art assets and their prompts are scattered across tools that each cover only part of the job (asset libraries without canvas, canvases without libraries, cloud-locked boards), and none keep all data local in the vault.

relations.evidence: PureRef is a canvas that doesn't manage a long-term library

summary: Art asset gallery that manages images, videos, audio and links with AI generation prompts in a masonry gallery and PureRef-style infinite canvas.
